Permutation Test for WGCNA Connectivity Loss

F. V. Rodriguez

2026-03-28

Overview

The WGCNA analysis (step 06) found that 12 of 13 DEG coexpression modules lose intramodular connectivity (\(\Delta k_{Within}\)) when comparing Inv4m to CTRL networks. A potential concern is that this connectivity loss could be an artifact of splitting samples by genotype: genes selected as DEGs will, by definition, have different mean expression between groups, and this could inflate correlation differences when networks are built separately.

This notebook addresses that concern with two complementary approaches:

  1. Genotype label permutation test: Shuffle genotype labels 1000 times, recompute \(\Delta k_{Within}\) per module, and compare the observed connectivity loss to the empirical null distribution. This directly tests whether the observed loss exceeds what random sample splitting produces.

  2. Topology control gene set: Apply the same analysis to 218 photosynthesis and senescence genes (Ojeda 2026) that are NOT differentially expressed between genotypes but DO have real coexpression structure driven by the leaf developmental gradient. If the connectivity loss is an artifact of sample splitting, these control genes should show the same pattern. If it is specific to DEGs, they should not.

Setup

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(WGCNA)

allowWGCNAThreads()
## Allowing multi-threading with up to 2 threads.
set.seed(42)
N_PERM <- 10000
RUN_DIR <- here("results/inversion_paper/field_perturbation/run_20251231_201332")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(RUN_DIR, "06_preservation")

FILTER_DIR    <- file.path(RUN_DIR, "02_gene_filter")
DATA_PREP_DIR <- file.path(RUN_DIR, "01_data_prep")
CONSENSUS_DIR <- file.path(RUN_DIR, "04_consensus_networks")
REFERENCE_DIR <- file.path(RUN_DIR, "03_reference_network")

source(here("scripts/utils/setup_paths.R"))
paths <- setup_project_paths("inversion_paper")

Load Data

# DEG-filtered expression (465 genes x 43 samples)
expr_filtered <- readRDS(file.path(FILTER_DIR, "filtered_expression.rds"))
sample_meta   <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_PREP_DIR, "sample_metadata.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
ctrl_modules  <- read_csv(file.path(CONSENSUS_DIR, "ctrl", "consensus_modules.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
SOFT_POWER    <- readRDS(file.path(REFERENCE_DIR, "ctrl", "selected_power.rds"))

# Full expression matrix (24k genes x 43 samples, PSU2022 only)
full_expr <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_PREP_DIR, "combined_expression.rds"))
if (inherits(full_expr, "EList")) {
  full_expr_mat <- full_expr$E
} else {
  full_expr_mat <- as.matrix(full_expr)
}

cat("DEG expression:", nrow(expr_filtered), "genes x", ncol(expr_filtered), "samples\n")
## DEG expression: 465 genes x 43 samples
cat("Full expression:", nrow(full_expr_mat), "genes x", ncol(full_expr_mat), "samples\n")
## Full expression: 24249 genes x 43 samples
cat("Soft power:", SOFT_POWER, "\n")
## Soft power: 18

Control Gene Sets

Photosynthesis and senescence hub genes from Ojeda 2026. In the companion phosphorus paper, we showed that the expression indices for these gene sets do not differ between Inv4m and CTRL genotypes. They are driven by the leaf developmental gradient (young leaves = photosynthesis, old leaves = senescence), providing biologically structured coexpression that is independent of the Inv4m introgression.

photo_genes <- read.table(
  file.path(paths$data, "photosynthesis_expression_index_genes_ojeda2026.txt"),
  header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)$V1

sag_genes <- read.table(
  file.path(paths$data, "senesence_hubs_ojeda2026.tab"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)$gene

# Exclude any overlap with DEGs
deg_genes <- ctrl_modules$gene
photo_control <- setdiff(intersect(photo_genes, rownames(full_expr_mat)), deg_genes)
sag_control   <- setdiff(intersect(sag_genes, rownames(full_expr_mat)), deg_genes)
control_genes <- unique(c(photo_control, sag_control))

cat("Photosynthesis (non-DEG, in matrix):", length(photo_control), "\n")
## Photosynthesis (non-DEG, in matrix): 163
cat("Senescence hubs (non-DEG, in matrix):", length(sag_control), "\n")
## Senescence hubs (non-DEG, in matrix): 55
cat("Combined control genes:", length(control_genes), "\n")
## Combined control genes: 218

Prepare Expression Matrices

# DEG module colors aligned to gene order
module_colors <- setNames(ctrl_modules$color, ctrl_modules$gene)
module_colors <- module_colors[rownames(expr_filtered)]

# Genotype labels
all_samples <- sample_meta$sample_id
true_labels <- setNames(sample_meta$Genotype, sample_meta$sample_id)
n_ctrl  <- sum(true_labels == "CTRL")
n_inv4m <- sum(true_labels == "Inv4m")
n_total <- length(true_labels)

# WGCNA format: samples x genes
datExpr_all     <- t(expr_filtered[, all_samples])
datExpr_control <- t(full_expr_mat[control_genes, all_samples])

cat("DEG matrix:", nrow(datExpr_all), "samples x", ncol(datExpr_all), "genes\n")
## DEG matrix: 43 samples x 465 genes
cat("Control matrix:", nrow(datExpr_control), "samples x", ncol(datExpr_control), "genes\n")
## Control matrix: 43 samples x 218 genes
cat("CTRL:", n_ctrl, "| Inv4m:", n_inv4m, "| Total:", n_total, "\n")
## CTRL: 20 | Inv4m: 23 | Total: 43

WGCNA Modules for Control Genes

Build modules from control genes using CTRL samples only, mirroring how the DEG modules were constructed.

datExpr_ctrl_only <- datExpr_control[which(true_labels == "CTRL"), ]
adj_ctrl_control <- adjacency(datExpr_ctrl_only, power = SOFT_POWER, type = "signed")
ctrl_tree <- hclust(as.dist(1 - adj_ctrl_control), method = "average")
ctrl_control_modules <- cutreeDynamic(
  dendro = ctrl_tree,
  distM = 1 - adj_ctrl_control,
  deepSplit = 4,
  minClusterSize = 10
)
##  ..cutHeight not given, setting it to 0.991  ===>  99% of the (truncated) height range in dendro.
##  ..done.
control_module_colors_raw <- labels2colors(ctrl_control_modules)

# Remap WGCNA standard colors to non-clashing names with matching hex
ctrl_color_remap <- c(
  turquoise = "sky",
  blue      = "peach",
  brown     = "jade",
  yellow    = "coral",
  green     = "lavender",
  black     = "umber",
  red       = "mustard",
  pink      = "rose",
  magenta   = "aqua",
  purple    = "spring",
  grey      = "grey"
)
# Hex codes for plotting (keyed by new name)
ctrl_color_hex <- c(
  sky      = "#5DA5DA",
  peach    = "#FAA43A",
  jade     = "#60BD68",
  coral    = "#F15854",
  lavender = "#B276B2",
  umber    = "#8D4B08",
  mustard  = "#DECF3F",
  rose     = "#F17CB0",
  aqua     = "#66E3D9",
  spring   = "#00FF7F",
  grey     = "grey"
)

control_module_colors <- ctrl_color_remap[control_module_colors_raw]
names(control_module_colors) <- control_genes

cat("Control modules found:", length(unique(ctrl_control_modules[ctrl_control_modules != 0])), "\n")
## Control modules found: 10
cat("Unassigned (grey):", sum(ctrl_control_modules == 0), "of", length(ctrl_control_modules), "\n\n")
## Unassigned (grey): 10 of 218
tibble(module = control_module_colors) |>
  filter(module != "grey") |>
  count(module, sort = TRUE) |>
  print()

Module Size Comparison

deg_sizes <- tibble(

  filter(module != "grey", !is.na(module)) |>

bind_rows(deg_sizes, ctrl_sizes) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n_genes, fill = type)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(DEG = "grey60", Control = "steelblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Module size (genes)", y = "Count", fill = NULL,
       title = "Module size distributions overlap between DEG and control")

Helper Function

compute_module_delta_k <- function(datExpr_a, datExpr_b, power, mod_colors) {
  adj_a <- adjacency(datExpr_a, power = power, type = "signed")
  adj_b <- adjacency(datExpr_b, power = power, type = "signed")

  k_a <- intramodularConnectivity(adj_a, mod_colors)
  k_b <- intramodularConnectivity(adj_b, mod_colors)

  delta_k <- k_b$kWithin - k_a$kWithin

  module_ids <- unique(mod_colors[mod_colors != "grey" & !is.na(mod_colors)])
  sapply(module_ids, function(m) {
    idx <- which(mod_colors == m)
    mean(delta_k[idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

# Violin plot panel constructor (used by kWithin and kME violin sections)
# points_df must have columns: module, z_observed, fdr
# fill_color: single color string OR named vector (module -> hex)
make_violin_panel <- function(violin_df, points_df, panel_title, fill_color) {
  if (length(fill_color) == 1) {
    p <- ggplot(violin_df, aes(x = module, y = z_value)) +
      geom_violin(fill = fill_color, color = "grey40", alpha = 0.6, scale = "width")
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(violin_df, aes(x = module, y = z_value, fill = module)) +
      geom_violin(color = "grey40", alpha = 0.6, scale = "width") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_color) +
      guides(fill = "none")
  }
  p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(
      data = points_df,
      aes(x = module, y = z_observed),
      color = "red", size = 3
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = points_df |> filter(fdr < 0.05),
      aes(x = module, y = z_observed, label = sprintf("FDR=%.3f", fdr)),
      color = "red", size = 3, vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression(Z[Delta * k]), title = panel_title)
}

Observed Delta kWithin

ctrl_idx  <- which(true_labels == "CTRL")
inv4m_idx <- which(true_labels == "Inv4m")

observed_delta <- compute_module_delta_k(
  datExpr_all[ctrl_idx, ], datExpr_all[inv4m_idx, ],
  SOFT_POWER, module_colors
)

observed_control <- compute_module_delta_k(
  datExpr_control[ctrl_idx, ], datExpr_control[inv4m_idx, ],
  SOFT_POWER, control_module_colors
)

cat("Observed mean delta kWithin per DEG module:\n")

Permutation Test

Shuffle genotype labels 1000 times, keeping group sizes fixed (20 CTRL, 23 Inv4m). For each permutation, recompute \(\Delta k_{Within}\) for both DEG and control modules. The module definitions remain fixed throughout.

null_deltas  <- matrix(NA, nrow = N_PERM, ncol = length(observed_delta))
colnames(null_deltas) <- names(observed_delta)
null_control <- matrix(NA, nrow = N_PERM, ncol = length(observed_control))
colnames(null_control) <- names(observed_control)

pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = N_PERM, style = 3)
##   |                                                                              |                                                                      |   0%
for (i in seq_len(N_PERM)) {
  perm_idx <- sample(n_total)
  pseudo_ctrl  <- perm_idx[1:n_ctrl]
  pseudo_inv4m <- perm_idx[(n_ctrl + 1):n_total]

  null_deltas[i, ] <- compute_module_delta_k(
    datExpr_all[pseudo_ctrl, ], datExpr_all[pseudo_inv4m, ],
    SOFT_POWER, module_colors
  )

  null_control[i, ] <- compute_module_delta_k(
    datExpr_control[pseudo_ctrl, ], datExpr_control[pseudo_inv4m, ],
    SOFT_POWER, control_module_colors
  )

  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}

Results

ECDF P-values

One-tailed test: fraction of permuted values \(\leq\) observed (testing for connectivity loss more extreme than the null).

ecdf_pvals <- sapply(names(observed_delta), function(m) {
  mean(null_deltas[, m] <= observed_delta[m])
})
ecdf_pvals_control <- sapply(names(observed_control), function(m) {
  mean(null_control[, m] <= observed_control[m])
})

DEG Modules

results_deg <- tibble(
  module = names(observed_delta),
  type = "DEG",
  n_genes = sapply(names(observed_delta), function(m) sum(module_colors == m, na.rm = TRUE)),
  observed_mean_delta_k = round(observed_delta, 4),
  null_mean = round(colMeans(null_deltas), 4),
  null_sd = round(apply(null_deltas, 2, sd), 4),
  ecdf_pvalue = round(ecdf_pvals, 4)
) |>
  arrange(ecdf_pvalue)

Control Modules

  module = names(observed_control),

Visualization

Permutation Null Distributions

Each panel shows the null distribution of mean \(\Delta k_{Within}\) from 1000 genotype label permutations. The red line marks the observed value. Grey panels = DEG modules; blue panels = control modules.

# DEG modules
plot_deg <- map_dfr(names(observed_delta), function(m) {
  tibble(module = m, type = "DEG", null_value = null_deltas[, m])
})
# Control modules (prefix to avoid color name collisions)
plot_ctrl <- map_dfr(names(observed_control), function(m) {
  tibble(module = paste0("ctrl_", m), type = "control", null_value = null_control[, m])
})
plot_data <- bind_rows(plot_deg, plot_ctrl)

obs_data <- tibble(
  module = c(names(observed_delta), paste0("ctrl_", names(observed_control))),
  type = c(rep("DEG", length(observed_delta)), rep("control", length(observed_control))),
  observed = c(observed_delta, observed_control),
  ecdf_pvalue = c(ecdf_pvals, ecdf_pvals_control)
)

module_levels <- c(sort(names(observed_delta)), sort(paste0("ctrl_", names(observed_control))))
plot_data$module <- factor(plot_data$module, levels = module_levels)
obs_data$module  <- factor(obs_data$module, levels = module_levels)

p_null <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = null_value)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density), fill = type),
    bins = 40, color = "grey50", alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(data = obs_data, aes(xintercept = observed),
             color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = obs_data,
    aes(x = observed, y = Inf, label = sprintf("p = %.3f", ecdf_pvalue)),
    vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "red", size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(DEG = "grey70", control = "steelblue")) +
  facet_wrap(~module, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    x = expression(Mean ~ Delta ~ k[Within] ~ "(permuted)"),
    y = "Density",
    title = "Genotype label permutation null for connectivity loss",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Red = observed; %d permutations. Grey = DEG modules, blue = control (non-DEG, Ojeda 2026)",
      N_PERM
    ),
    fill = "Gene set"
  )

print(p_null)

ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "permutation_null_delta_kWithin.pdf"),
       p_null, width = 16, height = 14)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "permutation_null_delta_kWithin.png"),
       p_null, width = 16, height = 14, dpi = 300)

|logFC| vs Delta kWithin

Scatterplot of Inv4m expression effect size against connectivity change, for DEG and control genes separately.

library(patchwork)

# Load DEG effects
effects <- read_csv(
  file.path(paths$intermediate, "predictor_effects_leaf_interaction_model.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
inv4m_effects <- effects |>
  filter(grepl("Inv4m", predictor), !grepl(":", predictor)) |>
  select(gene, logFC, adj.P.Val)

# Gene-level delta kWithin for DEGs
adj_ctrl_deg  <- adjacency(datExpr_all[ctrl_idx, ], power = SOFT_POWER, type = "signed")
adj_inv4m_deg <- adjacency(datExpr_all[inv4m_idx, ], power = SOFT_POWER, type = "signed")
k_ctrl_deg  <- intramodularConnectivity(adj_ctrl_deg, module_colors)
k_inv4m_deg <- intramodularConnectivity(adj_inv4m_deg, module_colors)

deg_dk <- tibble(
  gene = rownames(k_ctrl_deg),
  delta_kWithin = k_inv4m_deg$kWithin - k_ctrl_deg$kWithin,
  group = "DEG"
)

# Gene-level delta kWithin for control genes
adj_ctrl_c  <- adjacency(datExpr_control[ctrl_idx, ], power = SOFT_POWER, type = "signed")
adj_inv4m_c <- adjacency(datExpr_control[inv4m_idx, ], power = SOFT_POWER, type = "signed")
k_ctrl_c  <- intramodularConnectivity(adj_ctrl_c, control_module_colors)
k_inv4m_c <- intramodularConnectivity(adj_inv4m_c, control_module_colors)

ctrl_dk <- tibble(
  gene = names(control_module_colors),
  delta_kWithin = k_inv4m_c$kWithin - k_ctrl_c$kWithin,
  group = "Topology control"
)

# Merge with logFC and p-value
scatter_df <- bind_rows(deg_dk, ctrl_dk) |>
  left_join(inv4m_effects |> select(gene, logFC, adj.P.Val), by = "gene") |>
  mutate(
    abs_logFC = abs(logFC),
    neg_log10p = -log10(adj.P.Val)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(logFC))

# Correlations per group
cor_logfc <- scatter_df |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    rho = cor(abs_logFC, delta_kWithin, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
cor_pval <- scatter_df |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    rho = cor(neg_log10p, delta_kWithin, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kME (Module Eigengene Connectivity) Analysis

kME measures each gene’s correlation with its module eigengene. Unlike kWithin, kME is bounded [-1, 1] and does not scale with module size, making it directly comparable across modules.

# Compute module eigengenes for DEG modules in each genotype
datExpr_ctrl_sub  <- datExpr_all[ctrl_idx, ]
datExpr_inv4m_sub <- datExpr_all[inv4m_idx, ]

# Module eigengenes (CTRL)
me_ctrl <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr_ctrl_sub, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes
# Module eigengenes (Inv4m)
me_inv4m <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr_inv4m_sub, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes

# kME = correlation between gene expression and module eigengene
# Use signedKME which computes cor(gene, ME) for all genes x all MEs
kme_ctrl  <- signedKME(datExpr_ctrl_sub, me_ctrl)
kme_inv4m <- signedKME(datExpr_inv4m_sub, me_inv4m)

# For each gene, get kME to its own module
gene_names <- colnames(datExpr_all)
own_module <- module_colors[gene_names]

deg_kme <- tibble(
  gene = gene_names,
  module = own_module
) |>
  filter(module != "grey", !is.na(module)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    me_col = paste0("kME", module),
    kme_ctrl = kme_ctrl[[me_col]][which(colnames(datExpr_all) == gene)],
    kme_inv4m = kme_inv4m[[me_col]][which(colnames(datExpr_all) == gene)],
    delta_kme = kme_inv4m - kme_ctrl
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(gene, module, kme_ctrl, kme_inv4m, delta_kme)

# Module-level summary
kme_module_summary <- deg_kme |>
  group_by(module) |>
  summarise(
    n_genes = n(),
    mean_kme_ctrl = round(mean(kme_ctrl), 3),
    mean_kme_inv4m = round(mean(kme_inv4m), 3),
    mean_delta_kme = round(mean(delta_kme), 3),
    pct_decreased = round(mean(delta_kme < 0) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mean_delta_kme)

kME Permutation Test

Same genotype label permutation as kWithin, but computing delta kME per module instead.

# Helper: compute mean delta kME per module
compute_module_delta_kme <- function(datExpr_a, datExpr_b, mod_colors) {
  me_a <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr_a, colors = mod_colors)$eigengenes
  me_b <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr_b, colors = mod_colors)$eigengenes

  kme_a <- signedKME(datExpr_a, me_a)
  kme_b <- signedKME(datExpr_b, me_b)

  module_ids <- unique(mod_colors[mod_colors != "grey" & !is.na(mod_colors)])
  sapply(module_ids, function(m) {
    me_col <- paste0("kME", m)
    gene_idx <- which(mod_colors == m)
    mean(kme_b[[me_col]][gene_idx] - kme_a[[me_col]][gene_idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

# Observed
obs_kme_deg <- compute_module_delta_kme(
  datExpr_all[ctrl_idx, ], datExpr_all[inv4m_idx, ], module_colors
)
obs_kme_ctrl <- compute_module_delta_kme(
  datExpr_control[ctrl_idx, ], datExpr_control[inv4m_idx, ], control_module_colors
)

# ECDF p-values
kme_pvals_deg <- sapply(names(obs_kme_deg), function(m) {
  mean(null_kme_deg[, m] <= obs_kme_deg[m])
})
kme_pvals_ctrl <- sapply(names(obs_kme_ctrl), function(m) {
  mean(null_kme_ctrl[, m] <= obs_kme_ctrl[m])
})

kme_results_deg <- tibble(
  module = names(obs_kme_deg), type = "DEG",
  observed_delta_kme = round(obs_kme_deg, 4),
  null_mean = round(colMeans(null_kme_deg), 4),
  null_sd = round(apply(null_kme_deg, 2, sd), 4),
  ecdf_pvalue = round(kme_pvals_deg, 4)
) |> arrange(ecdf_pvalue)

kme_results_ctrl <- tibble(
  module = names(obs_kme_ctrl), type = "control",
  observed_delta_kme = round(obs_kme_ctrl, 4),
  null_mean = round(colMeans(null_kme_ctrl), 4),
  null_sd = round(apply(null_kme_ctrl, 2, sd), 4),
  ecdf_pvalue = round(kme_pvals_ctrl, 4)
) |> arrange(ecdf_pvalue)

# FDR across all
kme_all <- bind_rows(kme_results_deg, kme_results_ctrl) |>
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(ecdf_pvalue, method = "BH")) |>
  arrange(ecdf_pvalue)

cat("\n=== FDR-CORRECTED kME RESULTS ===\n")
## 
## === FDR-CORRECTED kME RESULTS ===
cat("DEG significant (FDR < 0.05):", sum(kme_all$type == "DEG" & kme_all$fdr < 0.05), "\n")
## DEG significant (FDR < 0.05): 9
cat("Control significant (FDR < 0.05):", sum(kme_all$type == "control" & kme_all$fdr < 0.05), "\n")
## Control significant (FDR < 0.05): 0
write_csv(kme_all, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "permutation_delta_kME_results.csv"))
saveRDS(
  list(observed_deg = obs_kme_deg, observed_ctrl = obs_kme_ctrl,
       null_deg = null_kme_deg, null_ctrl = null_kme_ctrl,
       pvals_deg = kme_pvals_deg, pvals_ctrl = kme_pvals_ctrl),
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "permutation_delta_kME.rds")
)

kME Z-score Violin Plot

# Z-score
kme_deg_z <- null_kme_deg
kme_deg_mean <- colMeans(null_kme_deg)
kme_deg_sd <- apply(null_kme_deg, 2, sd)
for (m in colnames(kme_deg_z)) {
  kme_deg_z[, m] <- (kme_deg_z[, m] - kme_deg_mean[m]) / kme_deg_sd[m]
}
kme_obs_z_deg <- (obs_kme_deg - kme_deg_mean) / kme_deg_sd

kme_ctrl_z <- null_kme_ctrl
kme_ctrl_mean <- colMeans(null_kme_ctrl)
kme_ctrl_sd <- apply(null_kme_ctrl, 2, sd)
for (m in colnames(kme_ctrl_z)) {
  kme_ctrl_z[, m] <- (kme_ctrl_z[, m] - kme_ctrl_mean[m]) / kme_ctrl_sd[m]
}
kme_obs_z_ctrl <- (obs_kme_ctrl - kme_ctrl_mean) / kme_ctrl_sd

# DEG violin
kme_deg_violin <- map_dfr(colnames(kme_deg_z), function(m) {
  tibble(module = m, z_value = kme_deg_z[, m])
})
# FDR across all kME modules (DEG + control)
# Positional indexing to avoid duplicate name collisions
n_kme_deg <- length(kme_pvals_deg)
n_kme_ctrl <- length(kme_pvals_ctrl)
all_kme_pvals <- c(kme_pvals_deg, kme_pvals_ctrl)
all_kme_fdr <- p.adjust(all_kme_pvals, method = "BH")
kme_fdr_deg  <- setNames(all_kme_fdr[1:n_kme_deg], names(kme_pvals_deg))
kme_fdr_ctrl <- setNames(all_kme_fdr[(n_kme_deg + 1):(n_kme_deg + n_kme_ctrl)], names(kme_pvals_ctrl))

kme_deg_points <- tibble(
  module = names(kme_obs_z_deg),
  z_observed = kme_obs_z_deg,
  fdr = kme_fdr_deg[names(kme_obs_z_deg)]
)
kme_deg_order <- kme_deg_points |> arrange(z_observed) |> pull(module)
kme_deg_violin$module <- factor(kme_deg_violin$module, levels = kme_deg_order)
kme_deg_points$module <- factor(kme_deg_points$module, levels = kme_deg_order)

# Control violin
kme_ctrl_violin <- map_dfr(colnames(kme_ctrl_z), function(m) {
  tibble(module = m, z_value = kme_ctrl_z[, m])
})
kme_ctrl_points <- tibble(
  module = names(kme_obs_z_ctrl),
  z_observed = kme_obs_z_ctrl,
  fdr = kme_fdr_ctrl[names(kme_obs_z_ctrl)]
)
kme_ctrl_order <- kme_ctrl_points |> arrange(z_observed) |> pull(module)
kme_ctrl_violin$module <- factor(kme_ctrl_violin$module, levels = kme_ctrl_order)
kme_ctrl_points$module <- factor(kme_ctrl_points$module, levels = kme_ctrl_order)

p_kme_deg <- make_violin_panel(kme_deg_violin, kme_deg_points,
                                "DEG modules (kME)", "grey70")
p_kme_ctrl <- make_violin_panel(kme_ctrl_violin, kme_ctrl_points,
                                 "Control modules (kME)", ctrl_color_hex)

p_kme_combined <- p_kme_deg / p_kme_ctrl +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
print(p_kme_combined)

ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "zscore_violin_kME_DEG_vs_control.pdf"),
       p_kme_combined, width = 10, height = 10)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "zscore_violin_kME_DEG_vs_control.png"),
       p_kme_combined, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)

Z-score Violin Plot (Main Figure Candidate)

Two-panel figure comparing connectivity disruption in DEG modules versus topology control modules. Z-scores are computed per module as \((observed - mean_{null}) / sd_{null}\). Red dots mark observed values.

# Z-score the null distributions
deg_null_z <- perm_null_data <- null_deltas
deg_null_mean <- colMeans(null_deltas)
deg_null_sd <- apply(null_deltas, 2, sd)
for (m in colnames(deg_null_z)) {
  deg_null_z[, m] <- (deg_null_z[, m] - deg_null_mean[m]) / deg_null_sd[m]
}
deg_obs_z <- (observed_delta - deg_null_mean) / deg_null_sd

ctrl_null_z <- null_control
ctrl_null_mean <- colMeans(null_control)
ctrl_null_sd <- apply(null_control, 2, sd)
for (m in colnames(ctrl_null_z)) {
  ctrl_null_z[, m] <- (ctrl_null_z[, m] - ctrl_null_mean[m]) / ctrl_null_sd[m]
}
ctrl_obs_z <- (observed_control - ctrl_null_mean) / ctrl_null_sd

# DEG violin data
deg_violin <- map_dfr(colnames(deg_null_z), function(m) {
  tibble(module = m, z_value = deg_null_z[, m])
})
# Compute FDR across all kWithin modules (DEG + control)
# Use positional indexing to avoid duplicate name collisions
n_deg <- length(ecdf_pvals)
n_ctrl <- length(ecdf_pvals_control)
all_kw_pvals <- c(ecdf_pvals, ecdf_pvals_control)
all_kw_fdr <- p.adjust(all_kw_pvals, method = "BH")
kw_fdr_deg  <- setNames(all_kw_fdr[1:n_deg], names(ecdf_pvals))
kw_fdr_ctrl <- setNames(all_kw_fdr[(n_deg + 1):(n_deg + n_ctrl)], names(ecdf_pvals_control))

deg_points <- tibble(
  module = names(deg_obs_z),
  z_observed = deg_obs_z,
  fdr = kw_fdr_deg[names(deg_obs_z)]
)
deg_order <- deg_points |> arrange(z_observed) |> pull(module)
deg_violin$module <- factor(deg_violin$module, levels = deg_order)
deg_points$module <- factor(deg_points$module, levels = deg_order)

# Control violin data
ctrl_violin <- map_dfr(colnames(ctrl_null_z), function(m) {
  tibble(module = m, z_value = ctrl_null_z[, m])
})
ctrl_points <- tibble(
  module = names(ctrl_obs_z),
  z_observed = ctrl_obs_z,
  fdr = kw_fdr_ctrl[names(ctrl_obs_z)]
)
ctrl_order <- ctrl_points |> arrange(z_observed) |> pull(module)
ctrl_violin$module <- factor(ctrl_violin$module, levels = ctrl_order)
ctrl_points$module <- factor(ctrl_points$module, levels = ctrl_order)

p_deg_violin <- make_violin_panel(deg_violin, deg_points,
                                   "DEG coexpression modules (kWithin)", "grey70")
p_ctrl_violin <- make_violin_panel(ctrl_violin, ctrl_points,
                                    "Topology control (kWithin)", ctrl_color_hex)

p_violin_combined <- p_deg_violin / p_ctrl_violin +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
print(p_violin_combined)

ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "zscore_violin_DEG_vs_control.pdf"),
       p_violin_combined, width = 10, height = 10)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "zscore_violin_DEG_vs_control.png"),
       p_violin_combined, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
